findings.title: Apply implicit anchor dependencies before reading constraintReference
findings.implementation: Resolve inherited reference axes through expression-stage anchor reads; include the same implicit dependencies in cycle validation. Authored references and axes written by expressions, drivers or active periodic motion retain their own values. Evaluator version is composition-evaluator-24.
coverage: Property and full-tree reads under both layer orders and shuffled seeks
Partially written axes and authored references
Self and indirect cycles with the authored expression diagnostic path
Driver overrides and active/inactive periodic writers
findings.red: The first three regressions failed before the fix; 33 existing expression tests passed.
findings.green: All 38 expression tests and the full fast checks pass.

findings.title: Preserve nested echo clocks or reject incompatible bakes
findings.implementation: Evaluate historical render-echo clocks with nested scopeTimes while retaining the current root frame. Sample only echoed content, descendants, parent transforms, constraints, expression/driver reads, clock dependencies, primitive blur and active skipUnchanged sourceRevision reads. Compatible samples become keys; conflicting or fractional layer times return comp-bake-time. A fixed positive primitive blur stops unused ancestor blur dependencies.
coverage: Original nested root-clock mismatch is refused with the expression diagnostic path
Compatible forward and reversed nested echoes preserve every render graph frame
Ancestor precomp echo includes descendant property history
Zero-decay echoes do not add historical requirements
Unrelated root and nested siblings still bake exactly
External expression and driver reads include source history
Historical parent transforms contribute to the echo
Ordinary echo parameters remain on the current clock
Own and inherited primitive blur include historical samples
sourceRevision uses historical samples only while skipUnchanged is active
Fixed positive own blur excludes overridden ancestor blur; legacy node/property periodic writers remain supported
findings.red: The original nested-clock regression failed before the fix. Subsequent acceptance regressions exposed over-broad sibling sampling, missing raw blur/revision dependencies and unused overridden ancestor blur sampling.
findings.green: All 30 bake-file tests pass, including 17 new regressions; final fast checks pass 1,442 tests.

checks.result: Expression and baked pixels, shuffled seeks, repeated MP4s and baked MP4s match exactly
Timing, visibility and reverse seeks match exactly

verification.initialExpandedTestFailure: The new driver fixture initially had one signal key; the existing schema requires two. Corrected the fixture without changing production validation and reran the full fast checks.
verification.policy: Local verification only; GitHub Actions remain prohibited. No baseline regeneration or performance tuning. CE6-P and CE9-F1 deferrals remain.
verification.runScope: Runtime, integration and frozen baselines ran after the anchor fix and initial echo fix, before the bake-only dependency refinement. Renderer/evaluator production code was unchanged during that refinement. Final fast and focused expression/evaluator browser checks ran after the completed bake implementation.
rejectedExperiments: Sampling all expression targets for every echo falsely refused unrelated sibling expressions; replaced with content and property dependency closure.
Excluding all raw effects missed primitive blur and historical sourceRevision; focused regressions reproduced both and the collector now follows those render reads.
Collecting all ancestor primitive blur parameters over-rejected an overridden blur; stop at a fixed positive nearer blur without expression or motion writers.
fixtureAndTypeRepairs: Initial inherited-blur test omitted the required group size; validation failed before bake. Added size:[200,200] without changing production validation.
Type checking caught optional legacy periodic.target in the blur override collector. Normalize target or node/property as in the existing evaluator and include that form in the override regression.
verification.independentReview: Standards and spec reviewers independently confirmed final own/inherited blur and revision refusal, inactive skip acceptance, unrelated sibling acceptance and overridden ancestor blur parity. No remaining findings from the bounded final checks.

delivery.strategy: One commit per finding; one final push after both commits and verification.
delivery.status: Both findings complete and verified. Delivery uses two finding commits and one final push to the PR branch. Remote head matches startingHead before delivery; post-push remote verification is reported in the chat.
